project_title: WorkPulse - Enterprise Employee & HR Service Portal
theme: Light & Dark Mode Adaptive (Default: Crisp Slate Light with Deep Navy Dark Mode Accent)
emotional_archetype: Archetype 1: Organic & Earthy meets High-Performance Productivity (Trust, Precision, Warmth)
design_persona: E1 Anti-AI Designer - Tactile High-Contrast Precision

tech_stack.components: Shadcn UI (Customized primitives: Dialog, Tabs, Select, Table, Badge, Avatar, Toast/Sonner)

typography.anti_default_rule: DO NOT use Inter or Roboto for headings. Use Manrope or Outfit for Headings and IBM Plex Sans / DM Sans for Body.

scale_hierarchy.small_label: text-xs uppercase tracking-widest font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400

color_system.contrast_rules: Always explicitly specify hover text colors. Never use generic full-screen gradients. Tint neutral grays with blue/slate undertones. APCA compliant contrast for all badges and buttons.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_philosophy: Generous Spacing (2-3x typical). Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-6 or p-8).
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: Bento Grid System - Mode B High Density Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6
layout_and_spacing.hero_punch_card: col-span-1 md:col-span-2 row-span-2 with high visual focus, live clock, GPS status, camera selfie preview modal
layout_and_spacing.card_style: Flat solid surfaces, subtle 1px border (border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800), rounded-xl, soft ambient shadow (shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow)

auth_module.description: Shared Login screen with Role Toggle (Employee / Admin-HR). Email/Employee ID + Password login. Quick demo credentials buttons for easy testing.

dashboard_view.header_nav: Sticky header with user avatar, name, designation, status badge (Punched In / Out), theme toggle, role switcher, logout.
dashboard_view.attendance_widget: Current time digital clock, Punch In / Punch Out button. Triggers camera selfie modal + simulated GPS coordinate capture (Latitude, Longitude, Accuracy). History log table with selfie thumbnails, punch time, location link, work duration.
dashboard_view.service_record_widget: Timeline view of employee journey: Joining Date, Department, Current Designation, Salary band, Transfer/Promotion history notes.
dashboard_view.quick_request_widget: Tabbed or Modal Form for Leave Request (Date range, Reason, Type), Advance Cash Request (Amount, EMI/repayment note, Reason), Payslip Request. Status tracker with color-coded badges (Pending: Amber, Approved: Emerald, Rejected: Rose).
dashboard_view.payslips_widget: List of available monthly payslips (Basic pay, HRA, Allowances, Deductions, Net Pay). PDF View / Download generator.

admin_hr_panel.description: Full HR Management view for Admin users to manage employees, verify attendance selfies, approve requests, and generate payslips.
views: Employee Directory & CRUD (Add new employee with ID, name, email, department, salary structure, designation).
Attendance Monitoring Board (Filter by date/employee, view selfie photos, GPS map pins, punch times, late flags).
Request Approval Queue (Review Leave, Advance, and Payslip requests with Approve / Reject actions + admin comments).
Service Record Manager (Add promotion, department transfer, or appraisal events to an employee record).
Payslip Generator & PDF Uploader (Form to enter basic, allowances, deductions, net salary or upload existing PDF file).

camera_and_gps_guidelines.camera_modal: Use navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia for live webcam selfie capture when Punching In/Out. Fallback to file upload/mock selfie capture if camera permission is denied.
camera_and_gps_guidelines.gps_geolocation: Use navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition to get latitude/longitude + street name reverse geocoding mock. Display location status tag ('Location Verified').

accessibility_and_testing.test_id_convention: All interactive elements MUST have role-based kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure both Employee View and Admin/HR View are seamless, rich in functionality, and fully interactive.
Provide mock data pre-populated with realistic employees, attendance records (with selfies and GPS tags), leave requests, advance requests, service timelines, and payslips.

Make the Punch In/Out workflow visually stunning: opening webcam video feed (or high quality camera UI fallback), showing real-time GPS coordinates, capturing the snapshot, and recording the attendance entry.
Ensure payslips can be generated dynamically as PDF/printable layout or previewed directly in a modal with breakups for basic salary, HRA, TA, PF, Tax, and net amount.
Add search, status filters, and date pickers across all lists and tables.
Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards with explicit hover states.
Include clear data-testid attributes on all interactive elements as defined in key_test_ids.
